title: Multilingual Source Tracing of Speech Deepfakes: A First Benchmark

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating source tracing model performance (Macro-F1) in cross-lingual transfer scenarios (training on one language or language family and testing on another) to measure performance degradation, asymmetric transfer biases, and English-centric pretraining biases.

Comparing model performance on seen versus unseen pseudo-speakers (derived via clustering) to test if models overfit to specific speaker identities (shortcut learning) rather than the actual generative source model artifacts.
